highlights: Glass panels: backdrop-blur(10px) over rgba(255,255,255,0.4) with 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.2) border
Shimmer animation on 'NEW' badge with conic-gradient rotating effect
Soft shadows throughout: 0 2px 4px rgba(145,158,171,0.16) on cards
Subtle noise/grain on hero background illustrations
Corner accent graphics: 53x53px decorative corner SVG overlays on feature cards
Bookmark decorative elements on feature cards (11x23px SVG positioned at top-left)
Logo marquee with horizontal gradient masks on both edges (36px-72px width fades)
Rotated card effects: transform rotate(-2.5deg) and rotate(1.9deg) on select feature cards
